title: Odal Node — Electronics Sector Data (v1.2.0)
description: ICT and electronics fields. Regulatory basis: Regulation (EU) 2023/1670 Art. 1(1) (ecodesign) and Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 (energy labelling), in force since 2025-06-20. Applicability dates and regulatory status are held in the sector manifest, not here. v1.2.0 narrows productCategory to the four device types Art. 1(1) actually enumerates (smartphone, other mobile phone, cordless phone, slate tablet) — laptop/monitor/tv/server/router/charger/earphone/pcb/other carried no regulatory basis and are removed. v1.1.0 corrects repairabilityScore to the structured {overall, criteria} shape; v1.0.0 declared it as a bare number, which the Rust type never produced.

energyEfficiencyClass.description: EU energy label class (A = most efficient, G = least efficient).

co2ePerUnitKg.description: Whole-lifecycle carbon footprint in kg CO2e per unit.

repairabilityScore.description: Repairability score (non-regulatory heuristic, not EN 45554 / EU 2023/1669). overall is 0.0-10.0; >= 6.0 is considered good.

sparePartsAvailable.description: Whether spare parts are commercially available from the manufacturer.

repairManualUrl.description: URL to the repair manual or repair information portal.

disassemblyInstructionsUrl.description: URL to disassembly or dismantling instructions.

svhcSubstances.description: SVHC substances present above 0.1% w/w per REACH Article 33.

rohsCompliant.description: Whether the product complies with RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU.

criticalRawMaterials.description: Critical raw materials present per EU CRM Act 2024/1252.

recycledContentPct.description: Recycled content as a percentage of total product weight.

expectedLifetimeYears.description: Expected product lifetime in years under normal use.

firmwareUpdateUntil.description: Date until which firmware or software updates are guaranteed (ISO 8601).

$comment: NO PASSPORT OBLIGATION. An act binds this product group today, but no act requires a digital product passport for it — the duty is either absent from the instrument entirely or discharged through another system under ESPR Art. 9(4)(b). This schema therefore describes data we model, not a passport the law asks for. Structural validation against it is not evidence of compliance with any passport obligation, and no binding passport determination may be emitted here. Removing this marker takes an act that actually imposes a passport; no status change can do it.
